name: sa-skills
description: Architecture documentation for Claude Code — creates and maintains ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/, its component index, explorer headers and release lifecycle, with every gate as code. Installs sa-records (ADRs, TDRs), sa-requirements (PO Spec, capability alignment), sa-analysis (risk analyses, traceability), sa-delivery (handoff kit, Word export, IcePanel sync, MCP index) and sa-visualization (the 3D command center with Alia) — 15 skills in the suite. An organization adds its own standards through an institution pack.
